arrangement.notes: Arrangement uses slow energy build with emphasis on vocal layers supported by sample-based textures and one-shot hits.

event_markers.label: Vocal Entry Verse 1
event_markers.reason: Begin vocal-focused section with aggressive delivery

event_markers.label: Energy rise Hook
event_markers.reason: Transition to energetic hook with one-shot hit accents

event_markers.label: Final Hook Peak
event_markers.reason: Vocal intensity climaxes with maximum energy

event_markers.label: Outro Drum Reduction
event_markers.reason: Lower energy and instrument dropout for outro

sound_intent.texture: sample-based with layered texture bed and sharp one-shot percussive hits
sound_intent.focus: vocals prominent and aggressive throughout arrangement
sound_intent.energy_profile: slow build to high intensity in hook and final hook

channels.drums: one-shot hits routed to percussion bus with transient shaping
channels.bass: sample slices routed to bass bus with compression
channels.chords: texture bed routed to harmonic bus with EQ
channels.melody: sampled melodic hits filtered and layered
channels.vocal: main vocal routed to lead bus with aggressive EQ and saturation
channels.fx: ambient and transition FX routed to effects bus

designer_intent.goal: Create an aggressive boom bap arrangement emphasizing vocal clarity and emotional intensity with a controlled slow energy buildup using sample slicing techniques.

presetor_intent.focus: Apply sample-slicing presets and texture layering with adaptation to vocal prominent mix

sensei_drum.brief: Create percussive arrangement using one-shot slicing techniques emphasizing groove and dynamics for boom bap style.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines using sample slices that complement the slow energy build and support the vocal aggressiveness.

harmony_generator.brief: Design harmonic texture bed using timestretch slicing to provide atmospheric yet rhythmically cohesive background.

melody_generator.brief: Create melodic sample-based hits to add interest while preserving vocal focus and overall arrangement clarity.

ai_designer.brief: Integrate and balance all layers focusing on energy curve and vocal prominence in the mix.

presetor.brief: Apply relevant production presets for sample slicing, vocal processing, and mix routing.

songgps.brief: Map out arrangement structure and energy transitions following boom bap genre conventions and aggressive mood.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Perform preliminary mix processing focusing on dynamic clarity and separation for sample-based elements and vocals.
